'''Maateen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the strong repression of Maateen authorities forced the [[Exchange]] to recruit new personnel to assure weapons shipment delivery to the planet.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Crackdown}}</ref>
